negative_snippets:
My family stayed at this hotel for one day, but the experience was very disappointing. The bathroom condition was not good and was not properly maintained.

The hotel management promised to provide breakfast for my whole family the next morning (aloo paratha and tea). However, the next day they did not provide any breakfast.

My family waited for almost 1–2 hours but nothing was served. After that, I tried calling them twice, but they did not answer the phone.

Very unprofessional behavior. If the hotel promises something to guests, they should fulfill it. I would not recommend this hotel based on my experience.
